author: Cynthesis
body:
So, I've been noticing playing today that many of the maps that I used to love very much are never in the cycles anymore. I know the Map Dev and others are working really hard to create more amazing maps, and I deeply appreciate that. However, I wish that we could bring back some of the older maps, too.

Some of the maps I really would like back online would be:
  • Bleened Rings
  • Rigor Mortis
  • Abandoned Park I
  • Abandoned Park II
If you feel like there are others that you feel deserve a second chance on this server, feel free to reply to this thread with more maps in mind.

Thanks for reading, hope to see you online! :)
